signals.title: Long-term resident threshold in 2027 — exit tax planning
signals.body: Your green card was issued in 2019. In 2027 you will reach the 8-year "long-term resident" threshold under IRC 877A. If there is ANY chance you might return to Taiwan long-term, consult an immigration tax specialist NOW.
